title: Multiplayer hidden-zone Search remains side-safe through submit, reconnect and undo barrier
steps: A private multiplayer match is prepared with Stack Search Event in Runner grip.
Runner submits Stack Search with an idempotency key.
Duplicate submit returns the stored receipt and stale submit is rejected.
Reconnect restores the Runner-only Search Choice with private option labels.
Corp payloads do not contain the private searched card title.
Runner resolves the Choice and the public event remains a hidden-info barrier.
Undo targeting the hidden-zone Search event is blocked.
